description:
Found by the specled_-dn4.9 audit (2026-07-26T00:25:30Z) while tracing item 2's path-identity fold. This is a real defect, not a cleanup.

dn4.5 normalized the per-test lane to repo-relative path identity, and dn4.9 item 2 extended repo-relative :files into the v1 records. But the v1 file-level detectors still join those repo-relative :files / owned_files against ABSOLUTE closure_files derived from raw module_info(:compile)[:source] — see lib/mix/tasks/spec.triangle.ex:447 and lib/specled_ex/review/coverage_closure.ex:132. A repo-relative string can never equal an absolute one, so execution_reach and untested_realization can never match.

Impact: those two detectors silently report nothing rather than reporting wrongly — same silent-failure class this epic spent the day correcting on the per-test lane, now visible on the v1 lane.

Fix: extend dn4.5's per_test_path_identity normalization to the v1 path so both sides of the join agree. Verify by constructing a case that SHOULD match and asserting it does — the current tests pass because nothing ever matches.
title: v1 file-level detectors can never match: repo-relative :files joined against absolute closure_files
